from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np, hashlib
p=Path('kopf_rgba_parallax')
for d in sorted(x for x in p.iterdir() if x.is_dir()):
    fs=sorted(d.glob('slice_*.png'))
    imgs=[np.asarray(Image.open(f).convert('RGBA'),dtype=np.uint16) for f in fs]
    a=np.stack([x[:,:,3] for x in imgs])
    # RGB disagreement where >1 layer carries alpha should be zero if slices came from one source image.
    rgb=np.stack([x[:,:,:3] for x in imgs])
    mask=a>0
    # weighted reconstruction and alpha aggregate; soft masks are expected to partition source alpha when summed/clipped.
    asum=a.sum(axis=0)
    nz=asum>0
    vals=[]
    for c in range(3):
        num=(rgb[:,:,:,c]*a).sum(axis=0)
        rec=np.zeros_like(asum); rec[nz]=num[nz]//asum[nz]; vals.append(rec)
    # compare pairwise RGB only where both layers have nonzero alpha
    maxdiff=0; pairs=0
    for i in range(len(imgs)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(imgs)):
            m=mask[i]&mask[j]
            if m.any():
                diff=np.abs(rgb[i].astype(np.int32)-rgb[j].astype(np.int32)).max(axis=2)
                maxdiff=max(maxdiff,int(diff[m].max()));pairs+=int(m.sum())
    print('DIR',d.name,'FILES',len(fs),'ALPHA_SUM_MAX',int(asum.max()),'UNION',round(float(nz.mean()),6),'OVERLAP_PIX',int((mask.sum(axis=0)>1).sum()),'RGB_OVERLAP_MAXDIFF',maxdiff,'RGB_PAIRPIX',pairs)
print('INTEGRITY_DONE=1')
PY
